-- Roblox GUI Script for Adding Cards
-- Run this in an executor
-- Made cooler with rounded corners and gradients
-- Frame is draggable (custom implementation since Draggable is deprecated)
-- GUI starts invisible, with a toggle button to show/hide
-- Added ResetOnSpawn = false for persistence across respawns
-- Added card selection dropdown with provided card types
-- Added "Random" option which sends [3] = nil for random cards
-- Uses Player object for target
-- Added ScreenGui.DisplayOrder = 4
-- Uses table.unpack with explicit length to send three arguments, [3] = nil for random, specific number for others

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Card types table, with Random first
local cards = {
    {name = "Random", num = nil},
    {name = "red 0 card", num = 11},
    {name = "red 1 card", num = 12},
    {name = "red 2 card", num = 13},
    {name = "red 3 card", num = 14},
    {name = "red 4 card", num = 15},
    {name = "red 5 card", num = 16},
    {name = "red 6 card", num = 17},
    {name = "red 7 card", num = 18},
    {name = "red 8 card", num = 19},
    {name = "red 9 card", num = 110},
    {name = "red reverse card", num = 10},
    {name = "red skip card", num = 111},
    {name = "red +2 card", num = 112},
    {name = "yellow 0 card", num = 21},
    {name = "yellow 1 card", num = 22},
    {name = "yellow 2 card", num = 23},
    {name = "yellow 3 card", num = 24},
    {name = "yellow 4 card", num = 25},
    {name = "yellow 5 card", num = 26},
    {name = "yellow 6 card", num = 27},
    {name = "yellow 7 card", num = 28},
    {name = "yellow 8 card", num = 29},
    {name = "yellow 9 card", num = 210},
    {name = "yellow reverse card", num = 20},
    {name = "yellow skip card", num = 211},
    {name = "yellow +2 card", num = 212},
    {name = "green 0 card", num = 31},
    {name = "green 1 card", num = 32},
    {name = "green 2 card", num = 33},
    {name = "green 3 card", num = 34},
    {name = "green 4 card", num = 35},
    {name = "green 5 card", num = 36},
    {name = "green 6 card", num = 37},
    {name = "green 7 card", num = 38},
    {name = "green 8 card", num = 39},
    {name = "green 9 card", num = 310},
    {name = "green reverse card", num = 30},
    {name = "green skip card", num = 311},
    {name = "green +2 card", num = 312},
    {name = "blue 0 card", num = 41},
    {name = "blue 1 card", num = 42},
    {name = "blue 2 card", num = 43},
    {name = "blue 3 card", num = 44},
    {name = "blue 4 card", num = 45},
    {name = "blue 5 card", num = 46},
    {name = "blue 6 card", num = 47},
    {name = "blue 7 card", num = 48},
    {name = "blue 8 card", num = 49},
    {name = "blue 9 card", num = 410},
    {name = "blue reverse card", num = 40},
    {name = "blue skip card", num = 411},
    {name = "blue +2 card", num = 412},
    {name = "Wild Card", num = 113},
    {name = "Wild +4 Card", num = 114}
}

-- Create ScreenGui
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "AddCardGUI"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false  -- Persist across respawns
ScreenGui.DisplayOrder = 4  -- Set display order
ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Toggle Button (always visible, to show/hide main frame)
local ToggleButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
ToggleButton.Text = "Toggle Add Card"
ToggleButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 30)
ToggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -130, 0, 10)
ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 255)
ToggleButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ToggleButton.TextSize = 14
ToggleButton.Parent = ScreenGui

-- Add UICorner to ToggleButton
local ToggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
ToggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
ToggleCorner.Parent = ToggleButton

-- Main Frame (initially invisible)
local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 180)  -- Increased height for new elements
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0.5, -90)
Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
Frame.Visible = false
Frame.Active = true  -- For interaction
Frame.Parent = ScreenGui

-- Add UICorner to Frame
local FrameCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
FrameCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
FrameCorner.Parent = Frame

-- Add UIGradient for cool background
local Gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
Gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new{
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 255))
}
Gradient.Parent = Frame

-- Selected Player Label
local SelectedPlayerLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
SelectedPlayerLabel.Text = "Select Player"
SelectedPlayerLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
SelectedPlayerLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
SelectedPlayerLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
SelectedPlayerLabel.TextSize = 14
SelectedPlayerLabel.Parent = Frame

-- Add UICorner to SelectedPlayerLabel
local PlayerLabelCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
PlayerLabelCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
PlayerLabelCorner.Parent = SelectedPlayerLabel

-- Select Player Button
local SelectPlayerButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
SelectPlayerButton.Text = "Choose Player"
SelectPlayerButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
SelectPlayerButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 30)
SelectPlayerButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
SelectPlayerButton.TextSize = 14
SelectPlayerButton.Parent = Frame

-- Add UICorner to SelectPlayerButton
local SelectPlayerCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
SelectPlayerCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
SelectPlayerCorner.Parent = SelectPlayerButton

-- Number TextBox
local NumberBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
NumberBox.PlaceholderText = "Enter number"
NumberBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
NumberBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 60)
NumberBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
NumberBox.TextSize = 14
NumberBox.Parent = Frame

-- Add UICorner to NumberBox
local NumberCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
NumberCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
NumberCorner.Parent = NumberBox

-- Selected Card Label
local SelectedCardLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
SelectedCardLabel.Text = "Select Card"
SelectedCardLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
SelectedCardLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 90)
SelectedCardLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
SelectedCardLabel.TextSize = 14
SelectedCardLabel.Parent = Frame

-- Add UICorner to SelectedCardLabel
local CardLabelCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
CardLabelCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
CardLabelCorner.Parent = SelectedCardLabel

-- Select Card Button
local SelectCardButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
SelectCardButton.Text = "Choose Card"
SelectCardButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
SelectCardButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 120)
SelectCardButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
SelectCardButton.TextSize = 14
SelectCardButton.Parent = Frame

-- Add UICorner to SelectCardButton
local SelectCardCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
SelectCardCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
SelectCardCorner.Parent = SelectCardButton

-- Add Card Button
local AddButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
AddButton.Text = "Add Card"
AddButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
AddButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 150)
AddButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
AddButton.TextSize = 14
AddButton.Parent = Frame

-- Add UICorner to AddButton
local AddCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
AddCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
AddCorner.Parent = AddButton

-- Player Dropdown List Frame (ScrollingFrame)
local PlayerListFrame = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
PlayerListFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 150)
PlayerListFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
PlayerListFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
PlayerListFrame.Visible = false
PlayerListFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
PlayerListFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

-- Add UICorner to PlayerListFrame
local PlayerListCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
PlayerListCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
PlayerListCorner.Parent = PlayerListFrame

-- Card Dropdown List Frame (ScrollingFrame)
local CardListFrame = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
CardListFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 200)  -- Taller for more cards
CardListFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
CardListFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
CardListFrame.Visible = false
CardListFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
CardListFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

-- Add UICorner to CardListFrame
local CardListCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
CardListCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
CardListCorner.Parent = CardListFrame

-- Function to populate player list
local function PopulatePlayerList()
    for _, child in ipairs(PlayerListFrame:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("TextButton") or child:IsA("UIListLayout") then
            child:Destroy()
        end
    end
    
    local ListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    ListLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    ListLayout.Parent = PlayerListFrame
    
    local players = Players:GetPlayers()
    for i, player in ipairs(players) do
        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        btn.Text = player.Name
        btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
        btn.TextSize = 14
        btn.LayoutOrder = i
        btn.Parent = PlayerListFrame
        
        local BtnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        BtnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
        BtnCorner.Parent = btn
        
        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            SelectedPlayerLabel.Text = player.Name
            PlayerListFrame.Visible = false
            print("Selected player: " .. player.Name)  -- Debug
        end)
    end
    
    PlayerListFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, #players * 30)
end

-- Function to populate card list
local function PopulateCardList()
    for _, child in ipairs(CardListFrame:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("TextButton") or child:IsA("UIListLayout") then
            child:Destroy()
        end
    end
    
    local ListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    ListLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    ListLayout.Parent = CardListFrame
    
    for i, card in ipairs(cards) do
        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        btn.Text = card.name
        btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
        btn.TextSize = 14
        btn.LayoutOrder = i
        btn.Parent = CardListFrame
        
        local BtnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        BtnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
        BtnCorner.Parent = btn
        
        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            SelectedCardLabel.Text = card.name
            selectedCardNum = card.num
            CardListFrame.Visible = false
            print("Selected card: " .. card.name .. ", Number: " .. tostring(card.num))  -- Debug
        end)
    end
    
    CardListFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, #cards * 30)
end

-- Selected card num variable
local selectedCardNum = nil

-- Toggle player dropdown on select button click
SelectPlayerButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if PlayerListFrame.Visible then
        PlayerListFrame.Visible = false
    else
        PopulatePlayerList()
        PlayerListFrame.Position = Frame.Position + UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 60)
        PlayerListFrame.Visible = true
    end
end)

-- Toggle card dropdown on select button click
SelectCardButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if CardListFrame.Visible then
        CardListFrame.Visible = false
    else
        PopulateCardList()
        CardListFrame.Position = Frame.Position + UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 150)
        CardListFrame.Visible = true
    end
end)

-- Add Card functionality
AddButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local targetName = SelectedPlayerLabel.Text
    if targetName == "Select Player" then
        print("Please select a player first.")
        return
    end
    
    local targetPlayer = Players:FindFirstChild(targetName)
    if not targetPlayer then
        print("Player not found: " .. targetName)
        return
    end
    
    local amount = tonumber(NumberBox.Text)
    if not amount or amount <= 0 then
        print("Please enter a valid positive number.")
        return
    end
    
    if SelectedCardLabel.Text == "Select Card" then
        print("Please select a card first.")
        return
    end
    
    -- Create table with three arguments
    local args = {
        [1] = targetPlayer,
        [2] = amount,
        [3] = selectedCardNum  -- nil for Random, number for specific card
    }
    
    -- Debug: Print the arguments being sent
    print("Firing AddEvent with args: Player=" .. targetName .. ", Amount=" .. amount .. ", CardNum=" .. tostring(selectedCardNum))
    
    -- Fire the remote exactly as in the provided example
    game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").AddEvent:FireServer(table.unpack(args, 1, 3))
    
    if selectedCardNum then
        print("Added " .. amount .. " " .. SelectedCardLabel.Text .. " to " .. targetName)
    else
        print("Added " .. amount .. " random cards to " .. targetName)
    end
end)

-- Toggle GUI visibility
ToggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    Frame.Visible = not Frame.Visible
    if not Frame.Visible then
        PlayerListFrame.Visible = false
        CardListFrame.Visible = false
    end
end)

-- Custom Draggable functionality for Frame
local dragging = false
local dragInput
local dragStart
local startPos

local function update(input)
    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
    Frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
end

Frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = Frame.Position
        
        local conn
        conn = input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
                conn:Disconnect()
            end
        end)
    end
end)

Frame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

game:GetService("UserInputService").InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        update(input)
    end
end)

-- Optional: Hide dropdowns if clicking outside
ScreenGui.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        if PlayerListFrame.Visible then
            local mousePos = input.Position
            local listPos = PlayerListFrame.AbsolutePosition
            local listSize = PlayerListFrame.AbsoluteSize
            if not (mousePos.X >= listPos.X and mousePos.X <= listPos.X + listSize.X and mousePos.Y >= listPos.Y and mousePos.Y <= listPos.Y + listSize.Y) then
                PlayerListFrame.Visible = false
            end
        end
        if CardListFrame.Visible then
            local mousePos = input.Position
            local listPos = CardListFrame.AbsolutePosition
            local listSize = CardListFrame.AbsoluteSize
            if not (mousePos.X >= listPos.X and mousePos.X <= listPos.X + listSize.X and mousePos.Y >= listPos.Y and mousePos.Y <= listPos.Y + listSize.Y) then
                CardListFrame.Visible = false
            end
        end
    end
end)
